name: labs/wetenschaap__pymista
title: Zaber microscopy stage (pymista.ZaberStage)
intro: Zaber microscopy stage (pymista.ZaberStage), adapted from wetenschaap/pymista. It reads `position`, `moving` and `homed`; runs `move_absolute`, `move_relative`, `home_axes` and `stop_motion`. `move_absolute`: move the axes to absolute positions in micrometres and wait until the stage is idle. The array names the leading axes in order; trailing axes keep their current position. A hardware driver: the market serves its fake backend, so no instrument is needed.
serve_http: PYTHONPATH=mhs/MHS/sdk/src python3 -m mhs serve mhs/MHS/drivers/labs/wetenschaap__pymista --backend fake --port 7400
serve_mcp: PYTHONPATH=mhs/MHS/sdk/src python3 -m mhs serve mhs/MHS/drivers/labs/wetenschaap__pymista --backend fake --mcp
